newsitem.title: USA: U.S. SEC briefly evacuated due to bomb scare.
newsitem.headline: U.S. SEC briefly evacuated due to bomb scare.

text.p: Officials evacuated the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission building for about half an hour Monday due to a brief bomb scare sparked by a suspicious package in the mail room, an SEC spokesman said.

Police were examining the package, which had been X-rayed and seemed suspect, but allowed the 1,500 to 1,600 officials, press and other users of the building to return after giving the all-clear. No further details on the package were immediately available other than that it was not a bomb.
There was no delay to the computerized SEC filings system.
